text:
**Saturday**, with Tae Kwon Do at 11:30 and the rest of the day free. Rest counts as part of a good week.

Next week is gear week at Tae Kwon Do, so you will need to arrive already wearing all of your gear. Lay it out this weekend so nothing goes missing. And if something good happened at the Boo Bash last night, it would make a nice happy thought for your Wonder Jar.
